one_liner: A young offering spirit shaped like a green bean.
A round mochi spirit with a crescent of cocoa.
A soft rice pouch spirit with a lucky tail.
A tiny chili ember with a bright flame.
A cool brine drop with a pale water bead.
A pepper spirit peels back its own warm little face.
A red-bean wishing bun steadies itself after every fall.
A toasted crisp spirit wears a stretchy cheese cape.
Three edible-flower spots mark its bright shell.
A cabbage spirit wraps itself around a spicy core.
Its paper husk opens to reveal a gentle ember face.
Two pepper-pod spirits hang from its leafy arms.
A wide lizard spirit wears colors from mixed offerings.
A layered wishing spirit holds a bright eye mark.
A sweet bun cat raises one paw to welcome visitors.
Sweet cocoa and a pepper crest make a strange pair.
A crunchy shell protects a warm spicy center.
A folded spirit keeps its cheese ribbon close.
A tall wrapped spirit sleeps inside its leafy sash.
A jelly-bright belly shines through its little wings.
A toasted skin back and curling tail keep it warm.
A blue rice-dumpling shell carries a lucky charm.
